content_sections.heading: PM SHRI School JNV Boudh Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) Mathematics Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI School JNV Boudh Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) Mathematics Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the PGT Mathematics post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the PGT Mathematics post at PM SHRI School JNV Boudh is scheduled for 10 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PGT Mathematics position?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates need a Two-Year Integrated Post Graduate M.Sc. in Mathematics from a Regional College of Education of NCERT with at least 50% marks, including B.Ed., or a Master's Degree in Mathematics with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed. degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the PGT Mathematics post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) Mathematics position is 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the PGT Mathematics role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the PGT Mathematics post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35750/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the PGT Mathematics post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) Mathematics position at PM SHRI School JNV Boudh.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including passport photos, Aadhar/PAN card, educational qualification certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the PGT Mathematics post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PGT Mathematics post will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is PM SHRI School JNV Boudh located?
faq.answer: PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Boudh is located in Paljhar, Boudh, Odisha.
